## Microsoft Store without the certification warnings
- Build → Build for Xbox → **Windows & Xbox app** (renamed from Xbox app) is now the recommended Store package: a UWP app on the WebView2 engine built into Windows, with no Chromium files of its own, so it passes the Windows App Certification Kit's "Blocked executables" test that the Electron .msix fails. One package covers Windows PCs and Xbox.
- Build for Windows → Microsoft Store and README-Store.txt now say so.
